extensionName: KUKA KRL Professional VS Code Extension

untrustedWorkspaces.description: KRL language parsing, syntax highlighting, and diagnostics are enabled. Remote communications, telemetry, and automated file packaging are disabled in Restricted Mode.

Core Language Features.title: KUKA KRL Language Support
Core Language Features.valueProposition: Provides core language support for KUKA KRL, including syntax highlighting, file associations (.src, .dat, .sub, .kfd), and language configuration.

Core Language Features.title: KRL Code Snippets
Core Language Features.valueProposition: Offers a collection of code snippets to speed up KRL programming.

Core Language Features.title: KRL Syntax Grammar
Core Language Features.valueProposition: Defines the TextMate grammar for accurate syntax highlighting of KRL files.

Core Language Features.title: Display Language
Core Language Features.valueProposition: Sets the display and interface language for the KUKA KRL extension UI, reports, and diagnostic tools.

Core Language Features.title: Silent Industrial Mode
Core Language Features.valueProposition: Disables non-critical UI notifications and prompts for a streamlined industrial environment.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Validate Workspace
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Performs a comprehensive validation of the entire KRL workspace for errors and warnings.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: KUKA KRL Safety Check
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Inspects KUKA KRL code for motion safety, velocity overshoots, and uninitialized tools using an integrated language model.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Toggle Safety Lens
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Toggles the display of safety-related inline diagnostics and warnings in the editor.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Toggle Error Lens
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Toggles the display of inline error messages and diagnostics in the editor.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Toggle Error Lens Inline Message
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Toggles the visibility of inline diagnostic messages shown by Error Lens.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Copy Problem Message
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Copies the diagnostic message of the current problem to the clipboard.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Copy Problem Code
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Copies the diagnostic code of the current problem to the clipboard.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Search For Problem
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Opens a web search for the current diagnostic problem message.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Disable Error Lens for Line
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Disables Error Lens diagnostics for the current line.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Enable Diagnostics
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Enables or disables all KRL language diagnostics.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check General Syntax
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Enables or disables general KRL syntax checking.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Warn on HALT
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Warns when a HALT instruction is encountered in the code.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Warn on WAIT without Timeout
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Warns when a WAIT instruction is used without a timeout, potentially leading to deadlocks.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check Safety Speeds
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Checks for adherence to safety-related speed limits in motion commands.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check Tool/Base Initialization
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Verifies that TOOL and BASE variables are properly initialized before use.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check Block Balance
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Ensures that control flow blocks (e.g., IF-ENDIF, LOOP-ENDLOOP) are correctly balanced.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check Dead Code
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Identifies and warns about unreachable or unused code segments.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check Type Usage
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Verifies correct data type usage and compatibility in KRL expressions and assignments.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check KRL Constraints
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Checks for common KRL programming constraints and best practices.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check Unused Variables
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Identifies and warns about declared variables that are never used.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check Duplicate Names
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Detects duplicate declarations of variables, functions, or subroutines.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check Advance Run
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Analyzes code for potential issues related to the KUKA advance run pointer.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check I/O Ranges
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Validates that I/O assignments and accesses are within defined ranges.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check DAT Integrity
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Ensures consistency and correctness of data files (.dat) associated with source files (.src).

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check CIRC Syntax
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Validates the syntax and parameters of circular motion commands (CIRC).

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check Interrupts
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Analyzes interrupt declarations and handlers for potential issues.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check Fold Balance
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Ensures that FOLD and ENDFOLD directives are correctly matched.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check Workspace Duplicates
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Identifies duplicate files or declarations across the entire workspace.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check Submit Wait
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Checks for proper usage of WAIT commands in submit interpreter programs.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Workspace Scan
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Enables or disables background scanning of the workspace for diagnostics.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check UTF-8 BOM
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Checks for the presence of a UTF-8 Byte Order Mark (BOM) in KRL files, which can cause issues on KRC controllers.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check Robot Reach
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Performs a basic check to estimate if robot target positions are within the robot's kinematic reach.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check Motion Fold Sync
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Ensures consistency between motion commands and their corresponding FOLD structures.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check VASS Standard
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Checks KRL code against the VASS (Volkswagen Audi Seat Skoda) programming standard.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check Path Approximation
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Analyzes motion paths for excessive approximation values that might affect trajectory accuracy.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check Switch Points
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Checks for proper usage and declaration of switch points in motion programs.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check Long Segments
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Identifies unusually long linear or circular motion segments that might indicate programming errors.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check VASS Strict Rules
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Applies stricter rules for VASS standard compliance checking.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check File Headers
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Verifies the presence and correctness of standard file headers in KRL files.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check Brake Usage
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Analyzes code for proper usage of brake commands and conditions.

Diagnostics & Linting.title: Check Shadowed Variables
Diagnostics & Linting.valueProposition: Detects variables that are declared in a scope where another variable with the same name already exists, potentially leading to confusion.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Format Document
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Formats the active KRL document according to configured style rules.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Remove Trailing Whitespace
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Removes unnecessary trailing whitespace from KRL code lines.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Sort Declarations
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Sorts variable and function declarations within KRL files for better readability.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Insert Fold
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Inserts a KRL FOLD/ENDFOLD block around selected code or at the cursor.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Unwrap Fold
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Removes a KRL FOLD/ENDFOLD block while preserving its content.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Cleanup Unused Variables
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Automatically removes unused variable declarations from KRL files.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Rename Signal
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Refactors KRL code by renaming a signal and updating all its references.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Convert to IIQKA Fold
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Converts legacy KRL folds to the IIQKA.OS-compatible fold syntax.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Insert Collision Guard
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Inserts a code block for collision detection and reaction into the KRL program.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Insert Spline Block
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Inserts a structured spline motion block into the KRL program.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Mirror Trajectory
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Mirrors a selected robot trajectory along a specified axis or plane.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Batch Shift Points
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Applies a batch shift or offset to multiple robot points in a trajectory.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Reverse Trajectory
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Reverses the order of points in a selected robot trajectory.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Renumber Points
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Renumbers robot points in a selected block of code sequentially.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Tool/Base Overview
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Provides an overview of all declared and used TOOL and BASE frames in the workspace.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Fold All
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Folds all foldable regions in the current KRL document.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Unfold All
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Unfolds all folded regions in the current KRL document.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Auto Fold
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Automatically folds KRL code blocks on file open.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Format On Save
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Automatically formats KRL documents when saved.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Remove Trailing Whitespace On Format
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Removes trailing whitespace as part of the formatting process.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Indent Width
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Specifies the number of spaces or tabs to use for indentation.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Separate Before Blocks
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Adds an empty line before control flow blocks during formatting.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Separate After Blocks
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Adds an empty line after control flow blocks during formatting.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Validate Non-ASCII Characters
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Checks for the presence of non-ASCII characters in KRL files, which can cause compatibility issues.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Indent Folds
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Indents the content within FOLD blocks.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Align Assignments
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Aligns assignment operators (=) in KRL code for better readability.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Enable Inlay Hints
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Enables or disables inline hints for KRL code.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Show WorkVisual User Tech Inlay Hints
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Displays inlay hints for WorkVisual User Technology parameters.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Enable Code Lens
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Enables or disables Code Lens features for KRL files.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Enable Call Hierarchy
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Enables or disables call hierarchy analysis for KRL functions and subroutines.

Code Editing & Formatting.title: Enable Document Highlights
Code Editing & Formatting.valueProposition: Enables or disables highlighting of all occurrences of a symbol in the current document.

Motion & Trajectory Tools.title: Estimate Motion Stats
Motion & Trajectory Tools.valueProposition: Estimates motion statistics and cycle times for selected KRL motion blocks.

Motion & Trajectory Tools.title: Convert Legacy to Spline
Motion & Trajectory Tools.valueProposition: Converts legacy PTP/LIN motion sequences into modern spline blocks.

Motion & Trajectory Tools.title: Robot Model
Motion & Trajectory Tools.valueProposition: Specifies the KUKA robot model for enhanced diagnostics and motion analysis.

Motion & Trajectory Tools.title: Long Segment Threshold (mm)
Motion & Trajectory Tools.valueProposition: Sets the threshold in millimeters for identifying long motion segments in diagnostics.

KRC Backup & Project Management.title: KUKA Backup Archive Explorer (.zip)
KRC Backup & Project Management.valueProposition: Provides a read-only explorer for KUKA KRC backup ZIP archives.

KRC Backup & Project Management.title: Open Backup ZIP Explorer
KRC Backup & Project Management.valueProposition: Opens a KUKA KRC backup ZIP archive in a custom explorer view.

KRC Backup & Project Management.title: Mount Backup ZIP As Project
KRC Backup & Project Management.valueProposition: Unpacks a KRC backup ZIP and opens it as a native workspace project with 2-way synchronization.

KRC Backup & Project Management.title: Sync All To Backup ZIP
KRC Backup & Project Management.valueProposition: Synchronizes all changes in the mounted project back to the original backup ZIP archive.

KRC Backup & Project Management.title: Export Backup ZIP
KRC Backup & Project Management.valueProposition: Exports the current workspace as a KUKA KRC backup ZIP archive.

KRC Backup & Project Management.title: Compare KRC Backup
KRC Backup & Project Management.valueProposition: Compares the current workspace or a local folder against a KRC backup archive.

KRC Backup & Project Management.title: Scaffold KRC Files
KRC Backup & Project Management.valueProposition: Generates boilerplate KRL files and directory structure for a new KRC project.

KRC Backup & Project Management.title: KUKA Event Log Inspector (.evt)
KRC Backup & Project Management.valueProposition: Provides a viewer for KUKA robot event log files (.evt).

KRC Backup & Project Management.title: Open Event Log
KRC Backup & Project Management.valueProposition: Opens a KUKA robot event log file in a custom inspector view.

KRC Backup & Project Management.title: Default Backup Open Mode
KRC Backup & Project Management.valueProposition: Controls how KRC backup .ZIP archives are opened by default (as project or preview).

KRC Backup & Project Management.title: Backup Project Window Mode
KRC Backup & Project Management.valueProposition: Determines whether mounted backup projects open in the current or a new VS Code window.

I/O & Signals.title: Refresh I/O View
I/O & Signals.valueProposition: Refreshes the KRL I/O view to show current signal states and declarations.

I/O & Signals.title: Show I/O Matrix
I/O & Signals.valueProposition: Displays an interactive matrix of KUKA robot inputs and outputs.

I/O & Signals.title: KRL I/O
I/O & Signals.valueProposition: Provides a dedicated view for monitoring and managing KUKA KRL inputs and outputs.

EKI & Communication.title: Validate EKI XML
EKI & Communication.valueProposition: Validates External KUKA Interface (EKI) XML configuration files for correctness.

EKI & Communication.title: Generate EKI Code
EKI & Communication.valueProposition: Generates boilerplate KRL code for EKI communication based on XML configurations.

Git & Version Control Integration.title: Clean Git Metadata
Git & Version Control Integration.valueProposition: Removes Git-related metadata from KRL files, useful before deploying to a robot.

Git & Version Control Integration.title: View File History
Git & Version Control Integration.valueProposition: Shows the Git commit history for the current KRL file.

Git & Version Control Integration.title: View Git Graph
Git & Version Control Integration.valueProposition: Displays a visual Git graph of the repository containing the KRL files.

Git & Version Control Integration.title: Show Line Blame Details
Git & Version Control Integration.valueProposition: Shows Git blame information (author, commit) for the current line in the editor.

Git & Version Control Integration.title: Diff With Previous
Git & Version Control Integration.valueProposition: Compares the current KRL file with its previous Git revision.

Git & Version Control Integration.title: Copy Commit Message
Git & Version Control Integration.valueProposition: Copies the commit message of the current line's Git commit to the clipboard.

Git & Version Control Integration.title: Toggle GitLens Inline Blame
Git & Version Control Integration.valueProposition: Toggles the inline Git blame annotations provided by GitLens integration.

Git & Version Control Integration.title: View Line History
Git & Version Control Integration.valueProposition: Shows the Git history for a specific line in the KRL file.

Git & Version Control Integration.title: Compare Two Revisions
Git & Version Control Integration.valueProposition: Compares two arbitrary Git revisions of a KRL file.

Git & Version Control Integration.title: Enable GitLens Current Line
Git & Version Control Integration.valueProposition: Enables or disables GitLens features for the current line in KRL files.

Git & Version Control Integration.title: Toggle GitLens Inline Blame
Git & Version Control Integration.valueProposition: Toggles inline Git commit author blame annotations in KRL files.

Licensing & Support.title: Activate License
Licensing & Support.valueProposition: Activates a KUKA KRL Professional license using a provided key.

Licensing & Support.title: Deactivate License
Licensing & Support.valueProposition: Deactivates the current KUKA KRL Professional license on this machine.

Licensing & Support.title: Check License Status
Licensing & Support.valueProposition: Displays the current status of the KUKA KRL Professional license.

Licensing & Support.title: Open Customer Portal
Licensing & Support.valueProposition: Opens the customer portal for managing KUKA KRL Professional licenses and subscriptions.

Licensing & Support.title: Start Trial
Licensing & Support.valueProposition: Starts a free trial period for KUKA KRL Professional features.

Licensing & Support.title: Request Corporate Invoice
Licensing & Support.valueProposition: Requests a corporate invoice for KUKA KRL Professional licenses.

Licensing & Support.title: Download Latest Invoice
Licensing & Support.valueProposition: Downloads the most recent invoice for KUKA KRL Professional purchases.

Licensing & Support.title: Activate Offline License
Licensing & Support.valueProposition: Activates a KUKA KRL Professional license in an offline environment.

Licensing & Support.title: Copy Machine Fingerprint
Licensing & Support.valueProposition: Copies the unique machine fingerprint required for offline license activation.

Licensing & Support.title: Check Support Status
Licensing & Support.valueProposition: Checks the current support status and availability for the KRL extension.

Licensing & Support.title: Support Gateway URL
Licensing & Support.valueProposition: Configures the URL for the KRL extension's support gateway.

Licensing & Support.title: Enterprise Host
Licensing & Support.valueProposition: Configures the corporate enterprise host for automatic floating Pro license activation.

Licensing & Support.title: License Server URL
Licensing & Support.valueProposition: Configures the on-premise enterprise license server URL for offline factory networks.

Licensing & Support.title: Dodo Payments API Key
Licensing & Support.valueProposition: Configures the API key for Dodo Payments integration.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: Open Control Center
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Opens the KUKA KRL Control Center dashboard for an overview of features and settings.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: Show Calculator
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Opens an integrated calculator for KRL-related calculations.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: Open Snippet Generator
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Opens a tool to generate custom KRL code snippets.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: Show Flowchart
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Generates and displays a visual flowchart of the KRL program's logic.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: Activate File Icons
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Activates the custom KRL file icon theme for better file identification.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: Send Selection to Telegram Chat
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Sends the currently selected code to a configured Telegram chat.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: Open Telegram Chat
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Opens the configured Telegram chat for KRL support or discussion.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: Send To Developer
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Sends diagnostic information or code snippets to the extension developers for support.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: Switch Display Language
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Allows switching the display language of the KRL extension UI.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: Accept Review
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Accepts the current code review change or suggestion.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: Accept All Reviews
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Accepts all pending code review changes or suggestions.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: Reject Review
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Rejects the current code review change or suggestion.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: Reject All Reviews
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Rejects all pending code review changes or suggestions.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: Refresh Fleet Explorer
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Refreshes the KRL Fleet Explorer view to update robot connection statuses.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: Prompt VKRC Pro
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Prompts for VKRC Pro related actions or information.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: Check VKRC Status
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Checks the status of VKRC (Virtual KUKA Robot Controller) integration.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: View Robot Image
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Displays an image of the configured KUKA robot model.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: Configure WorkVisual Path
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Configures the path to the KUKA WorkVisual installation for integration.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: KUKA KRL Professional
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Provides a dedicated activity bar container for KUKA KRL Professional views.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: KRL Fleet Explorer
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Displays and manages connected KUKA robot controllers in a fleet overview.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: KRL Commands
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Provides a quick access panel for frequently used KUKA KRL commands.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: Enable Telemetry
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Enables or disables telemetry data collection for extension usage.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: WorkVisual Path
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Specifies the installation path for KUKA WorkVisual.

UI & Workflow Tools.title: WorkVisual Images Path
UI & Workflow Tools.valueProposition: Specifies the path to WorkVisual image assets for display in the extension.

Reporting.title: Generate Report
Reporting.valueProposition: Generates a detailed report of the KRL code and workspace analysis.

Reporting.title: Generate Acceptance Report
Reporting.valueProposition: Generates a formal acceptance report for KRL projects, often used in commissioning.

Reporting.title: Report Language
Reporting.valueProposition: Sets the language for generated KRL reports.

Reporting.title: Report Collapsible Sections
Reporting.valueProposition: Determines if sections in generated reports are collapsible.

Reporting.title: Company Name for Reports
Reporting.valueProposition: Sets the company name to be included in generated KRL reports.

Reporting.title: Company Logo Path for Reports
Reporting.valueProposition: Specifies the path to a company logo image to be included in generated KRL reports.

Themes & Icons.title: KRL Industrial Dark
Themes & Icons.valueProposition: A dark color theme optimized for KRL programming in industrial environments.

Themes & Icons.title: KRL Industrial Light
Themes & Icons.valueProposition: A light color theme optimized for KRL programming in industrial environments.

Themes & Icons.title: KRL Midnight OLED
Themes & Icons.valueProposition: A deep dark color theme designed for OLED displays, reducing eye strain.

Themes & Icons.title: KRL Blueprint
Themes & Icons.valueProposition: A unique dark color theme with a blueprint-like aesthetic.

Themes & Icons.title: KRL WorkVisual Dark (Standard)
Themes & Icons.valueProposition: A dark color theme mimicking the default appearance of KUKA WorkVisual.

Themes & Icons.title: KRL WorkVisual Light (Standard)
Themes & Icons.valueProposition: A light color theme mimicking the default appearance of KUKA WorkVisual.

Themes & Icons.title: KRL File Icons
Themes & Icons.valueProposition: Provides custom file icons for KRL-related file types.
